affected_predicate.description: An integer representing Beijing's highest temperature today in Celsius is visibly obtained and returned.

competing_trace_defects.description: The agent pressed VERIFY after selecting only part of the visible fire-hydrant set; the challenge remained active and displayed "Please select all matching images."
Before and after the reuse target, reCAPTCHA challenges repeatedly expired or restarted, visibly preventing progress to search results.

chains.rationale: The reused summary incorrectly stated that verification had expired, while the target GUI visibly showed an active crosswalk challenge. The target prediction relied on the accurate selected-square portion and continued selecting a plausible crosswalk square, so no harmful bridge from the inaccurate statement is visible. Later CAPTCHA expirations, repeated challenges, and incomplete fire-hydrant selection are independently observable. No search result or requested Celsius integer appears in the supplied trace.

summary: The inaccurate expired-challenge statement caused no visible local harm at reuse because the agent continued the active crosswalk challenge. Independent recurring CAPTCHA problems remained observable, and the requested integer temperature was never visibly obtained or returned.
